proposal.reason: Main change is symmetric-memory collective batching: grouped AllReduce/AllGather/ReduceScatter planning and kernel selection, multi-work argument layout/dispatch, CTA/work-range slicing, and symmetric device-kernel execution updates (including LL eligibility, per-work offsets/strides, and symmetric scheduler behavior). Other edits (shared launch/plan plumbing and tests/docs) support this feature rather than introducing an independent module change.
